# use-and

Require And instead of repeating the previous step keyword.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| formatting | no | yes | none |

Reports and safely replaces a step keyword that repeats the previous one with `And`. `*` counts as `And`.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "use-and": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
Given a cart
Given a coupon
```
